mechanism.forced_participant: Holders of expiring quarterly delivery contracts - Binance USD(S)-M quarterlies (BTCUSDT_260925-class, deliveryDate-verified above) whose positions are force-closed against the delivery settlement at 08:00 UTC and who therefore MUST complete their roll/unwind before that instant - plus quarter-end options and futures expiring at the same 08:00 UTC instant on coincident venues (Deribit month/quarter-end expiries verified above) whose dealers must finish terminal gamma-hedge rebalancing by the same deadline. The coercion is the published delivery schedule, a deterministic public clock, not any endogenous price/OI/funding state.
mechanism.late_participant: Unhurried liquidity providers and post-deadline flow that only re-quote/re-engage after the delivery instant has passed and the forced population is gone.
mechanism.why_effect_exists: Roll and terminal-hedge flow is deadline-bound and one-sided: as 08:00 UTC approaches, the residual forced flow must transact in a shrinking window on the perp book (the deepest leg where quarter-roll hedges transmit), so accumulated pre-expiry taker pressure continues to push price into the deadline instead of instantly clearing. The observable is that terminal drift: the side of accumulated net pressure over the expiry-morning hours, held only across the final pre-delivery window and flat at the delivery instant.
when_it_must_fail: If quarter-roll flow is two-sided/balanced (net terminal pressure ~ noise), anchor after-cost expectancy is statistically indistinguishable from zero.
If the drift is generic Friday H1 imbalance autocorrelation with no deadline content, the shifted-Friday sham reproduces the anchor (same-sign >= 0.5x) and the family is falsified as a re-clocking.
If the book is a bare last-Friday-clock artifact, the clock-only shadow out-earns the anchor or correlates > 0.20 with it.
If the book is a holiday-thin-liquidity-level exposure in disguise (2025-12-26 is Boxing Day), D2 pooled |rho| > 0.20 vs the dvol proxies (WKNDLIQ's killers) vetoes it before selection.

observable_pinned.definition: press(symbol, e) = (SUM buy_quote over bars A-8..A-3 - SUM sell_quote over bars A-8..A-3) / (SUM quote_total over bars A-8..A-3), a bounded net-pressure ratio in [-1, +1] computed on the 00:00..06:00 UTC bars of expiry day, fully closed and PIT at decision time (06:00 UTC)
observable_pinned.instant_source: deterministic derivatives calendar: last Friday of Mar/Jun/Sep/Dec at 08:00 UTC, rule verified against Binance fapi deliveryDate and Deribit expiration_timestamp metadata (see spec_verification)

clock.bar: H1 UTC from the frozen S4 panels, bar hour_utc=T covers [T, T+1h)
clock.expiry_bar: A(e) = the bar whose hour_utc equals 08 on the expiry date (the delivery instant 08:00 UTC is the OPEN boundary of A and the CLOSE boundary of A-1; e.g. 2025-09-26T08:00:00Z -> bar '2025-09-26T08')
clock.pressure_window: bars A-8..A-3 = hours 00..05 UTC of expiry day (six closed bars)
clock.decision: at the CLOSE of bar A-3 = 06:00 UTC, when every pressure-window bar is point-in-time
clock.exit_boundary: at the CLOSE of bar A-1 = 08:00 UTC = the delivery instant itself; the anchor is FLAT at and after the delivery instant and never touches the expiry bar A
clock.instant_alignment: pure UTC arithmetic on the frozen H1 index; no DST anywhere in this clock (delivery epochs verified at 08:00:00Z exactly)

warmup.rule: an event is eligible only if every bar referenced by any arm of this family (deepest = neighbour's A-12 through exit bar A-1) exists inside the frozen panel bounds; no minimum-history convention beyond construction (features need <= 10 bars)
warmup.coverage: panel starts 2025-08-22T00; first event 2025-09-26 needs bars from 2025-09-25T20 - exists; therefore ALL 4 quarterly events x 3 symbols are eligible; no event dropped
warmup.signal_history: none required beyond the pressure window itself (no threshold fitting exists)

columns_from_panel.buy_quote: USD notional of buy-taker flow in bar
columns_from_panel.sell_quote: USD notional of sell-taker flow in bar
columns_from_panel.last_price: last traded price in bar, used as the bar-close fill price

features_lags.lag_structure: windowed feature at lags -8..-3 relative to the expiry bar (anchor); neighbour deepens to lags -12..-3; decision lag -3 close (06:00 UTC); exit lag -1 close (08:00 UTC). Volume enters only as a bounded ratio denominator; no volume LEVEL is used anywhere; no other lags, no rolling windows, no fitted parameters.

entry_exit_fills.direction: d = sign(press) = sign((SUM buy_quote - SUM sell_quote)/(SUM quote_total)) over bars A-8..A-3; tie (numerator exactly 0) -> decision recorded UNFUNDED_SKIP (counted, not silently dropped)
entry_exit_fills.entry: at close of bar A-3 (06:00 UTC), fill price = last_price of bar A-3, unit notional 1.0 per decision per symbol, no leverage parameter, no sizing conditioning
entry_exit_fills.exit: at close of bar A-1 (08:00 UTC, the delivery instant), fill price = last_price of bar A-1; no stop, no early exit
entry_exit_fills.fills_per_funded_decision: 2 (entry + exit), each charged cost exactly once (L-V14-0)

costs.authority: measured taker + spread schedule at stress tier 2.0 as PRIMARY (Q-2/Q-8), inherited from the V17 scored-driver kernel adoption at this cycle's P1 phase; cost exactly once per fill
costs.invention_disclaimer: NO cost constant is stated or invented in this proposal; the measured tier numbers come from the kernel's measured schedule at execution time. Measured beats stated everywhere.

anchor.rule: direction = sign(press over A-8..A-3); entry close of A-3; exit close of A-1; H = 2 bars (exposure spans 06:00..08:00 UTC, the terminal pre-delivery window)
anchor.decisions: 4 quarterly events x 3 symbols = 12 funded decisions (minus exact-tie skips, expected 0)

neighbour.rule: identical decision instant, entry and exit; pressure window deepened to A-12..A-3 (10 bars, 20:00 UTC previous day .. 06:00 UTC expiry day)
neighbour.mechanism_support: if deadline-bound roll flow is real, a deeper accumulation window captures more of the forced flow and must move the same direction; an unstable or sign-flipping deeper window contradicts the mechanism (different parameterization, same mechanism)

causal_placebo_control.identifiability: the sham lands on real alternate Fridays with real microstructure, one week before the true deadline; it CAN move the signal (Q-11 satisfied; a control that cannot move the signal would be INVALID NULL)

representation_identity.p12_statement: This block IS the representation D2 must measure pooled |rho| <= 0.20 on. Representation identity = measurement identity (FXFV9 lesson: no undisclosed variant grids).
representation_identity.grid: H1 rows keyed (symbol, hour_utc) from the three frozen S4 panels (digests pinned in p0_gate.json s4_repin); decision grid = 12 rows keyed (symbol, quarterly_instant) over the 4 deterministic instants 2025-09-26/2025-12-26/2026-03-27/2026-06-26 at 08:00 UTC
representation_identity.signal_computation: per decision row: press = (SUM_{A-8..A-3} buy_quote - SUM sell_quote) / SUM quote_total; d = sign(press); entry = last_price(A-3) filled 06:00 UTC; exit = last_price(A-1) filled 08:00 UTC (delivery instant)
representation_identity.per_decision_return: r = d * (exit/entry - 1), gross; after-cost r_net = r - 2 * fill_cost_tier2.0 / unit_notional
series_d2_measures: the 12-row per-decision after-cost return vector of ANCHOR (primary)
the same vectors for NEIGH-W10 for the ancestry panel
representation_identity.books: per-symbol books and the pooled 3-symbol book; equal unit notional per decision; no cross-sectional ranking, no normalization across symbols
representation_identity.no_hidden_variants: no alternate window depth, no monthly-grid variant, no sign-flipped re-computation exists or may be substituted at D2; any re-measure must use exactly this representation or be recorded as a NEW proposal

ancestry_defense: WKNDLIQ was a Sat/Sun recurring weekday calendar whose book was measured to BE a low-liquidity-level exposure (pooled |rho| 0.5628 vs dvol proxies); P1's clock is 4 sparse FRIDAY instants with full weekday sessions, all fills land Friday 06:00-08:00 UTC (never into a weekend), and the observable is a bounded side-ratio in which the volume level cancels - the likeliest residual leakage path (2025-12-26 Boxing Day thin liquidity) is explicitly disclosed and the dvol_level_log/dvol_shock proxies are P1's named F3 kill. OICASCADE was an endogenous OI-collapse event book killed by its own randomized-event sham; P1 consumes NO OI anywhere, detects nothing endogenously, and carries a shifted-Friday sham of the same falsifying family. ATTN-PHASE was a daily recurring US-session phase on SOL; P1 has no session conditioning, treats all three symbols symmetrically, and reacts to flow direction, not to a time-of-day phase. FUNDJUMP still carried the funding LEVEL (rho 0.2439); P1 consumes no funding. CLOSE-DISPLACE-FADE and RUNPERSIST are endogenous UTC-day-boundary forms dead at any clock; P1's bars are anchored on 08:00 UTC delivery arithmetic, not the day boundary, and the anchor is flat before the delivery instant.
distinctness_vs_sibling: P1's information source is PRE-instant accumulated taker pressure (00:00..06:00 UTC expiry-morning roll flow) on the QUARTERLY delivery clock, with a drift-into-deadline continuation reaction that is flat at 08:00 UTC. P2 (CNG1-A5-P2) uses the POST-settlement expiry-hour flow on the NON-QUARTERLY monthly options-expiry clock with an unwind-reversal reaction entered at 09:00 UTC. Different information-source layer, different reaction form, and disjoint event dates (quarterly vs non-quarterly last Fridays; FOMC instants of lane A4 also disjoint from both grids - checked). Cross-proposal collapse is tested by frozen rule F5.

expected_failure_interpretation: If F1 fires, the quarterly delivery clock carries no incremental information beyond generic Friday imbalance continuation and the roll-drift mechanism is dead on this substrate - it must NOT be re-clocked to other expiry series (the monthly clock is already P2's separate test; re-parameterizing windows after seeing that would be rescue). If F3 fires on the dvol proxies, the family was secretly a calendar-conditioned liquidity exposure - exactly the WKNDLIQ death the lane pre-disclosed, and an honest kill. If F4 fires with controls coherent (anchor loses, sham/shadow also lose), it is a plain negative: quarter-roll terminal flow is either balanced noise at H1 granularity or fully eaten by measured tier-2.0 costs. Any of these outcomes feeds CRYPTO_NG1_REJECT_ALL, which the plan registers as a successful research run.
